name: Toaster Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a rounded orange toaster with a cheeky face and two slices of toast popping out
entry: It pops out toast so hot it bursts into flame. It gets grumpy if nobody eats it.
how: Use a Toaster Coil on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Fire Blast in this form.
